moment.text: All the Little Masters followed Marcantonio in engraving mythological scenes, roundly drawn nudes, and the kind of erotic subjects that appear whenever a great tradition breaks up, whether in late antiquity, the end of the Renaissance, or our own time.

matters.text: Leda and the Swan is a story and subject in art from Greek mythology in which the god Zeus, in the form of a swan, seduces Leda, an Aetolian princess who became Spartan queen.

Thanks to the literary renditions of Ovid and Fulgentius, it was a well-known myth through the Middle Ages, but emerged more prominently as a classicizing theme with erotic overtones in the Italian Renaissance.
